name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
tagline: Moderate-return industrial-packaging maker (~11-15% growth, ROE ~11%) with a capacity-utilisation story but no real catalyst — VP thread dead since 2024, 'neither'
business_overview: Pyramid Technoplast (incorporated 1997) manufactures HM-HDPE plastic containers, IBC (intermediate bulk) containers, drums, barrels and cans, serving chemical, agrochemical, specialty-chemical and pharmaceutical customers. ValuePickr thread has only 3 posts, all from February 2024 — effectively dead.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 681 Cr; FY27 guidance ~15% revenue growth at ~11-12% EBITDA margin
fundamentals_narrative: Returns are moderate (ROCE ~13.5%, ROE ~10.7%), growth is ~11% with FY27 guidance around 15% at an 11-12% EBITDA margin, and the balance sheet is comfortable (D/E ~11%). The investment story is operating leverage from rising capacity utilisation, but there is no specific named catalyst, and the source curator's own framing (in the old project) explicitly called this the more speculative/opportunistic name in its cohort.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. 52-week range Rs 132-199 — a fairly narrow band, consistent with a low-volatility, moderate-growth name.
